enemies.name: Experimental Subject F-009
enemies.flavour_text: This Army experimental subject seems to have once been a cloudbeast. It straightens its back, showing off its non-existent front claws.

abilities.text: Recovers HP when affected by a <Leak Source>.

enemies.name: Rampaging F-009
enemies.flavour_text: This Army experimental subject seems to have once been a cloudbeast. It straightens its back, showing off its non-existent front claws, and rubs people with its non-existent neck, making a wet purring sound it remembers people liking.

abilities.text: Recovers HP when affected by a <Leak Source>.

enemies.name: Experimental Subject R-044
enemies.flavour_text: This Army experimental subject seems to have once been a musbeast. It still likes to touch the ground with its nose, which is now a metal gun barrel.

abilities.text: Next attack deals Arts damage when affected by a <Leak Source>.

enemies.name: Rampaging R-044
enemies.flavour_text: This Army experimental subject seems to have once been a musbeast. It still likes to touch the ground with its nose, which is now a metal gun barrel. It seems unconcerned with the trail of uninhabited areas it leaves in its wake, leisurely stuffing its cheeks with grain.

abilities.text: Next attack deals Arts damage when affected by a <Leak Source>.

enemies.name: Heterogeneous Fungi
enemies.flavour_text: Once a regular sight on the dinner tables of Ursus, found in soups along with cream, black pepper and flour. It has escaped this fate.

abilities.text: Continuously channels at a Leak Marker in attack range, causing it to create Leak Sources and gaining increased DEF.

enemies.name: Sanguine Heterogeneous Fungi
enemies.flavour_text: Once a regular sight on the dinner tables of Ursus, found in soups along with cream, black pepper and flour. It has escaped this fate. Its foe is no longer a soup spoon, but crossbow bolts.

abilities.text: Continuously channels at a Leak Marker in attack range, causing it to create Leak Sources and gaining increased DEF.

enemies.name: Rockbreaker
enemies.flavour_text: How does moss lift a rock? The Army's researchers tried gene sequencing, chemicals, etc. Until one day its spores fell upon the carcass of a mutated animal.

abilities.text: Splits when first affected by a <Leak Source>.

enemies.name: Sanguine Rockbreaker
enemies.flavour_text: How does moss lift a rock? The Army's researchers tried gene sequencing, chemicals, etc. Until one day its spores fell upon the carcass of a mutated animal. It is quite happy about what happened—people now run away from it screaming. This once insignificant creature has finally earned respect.

abilities.text: Splits when first affected by a <Leak Source>.

enemies.name: Experimental Subject A-000
enemies.flavour_text: This Army experimental subject seems to have once been a fowlbeast. When its dark cage is opened, it flaps its wings, but it takes to the air in a different way.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Death deals a large amount of Physical damage to surrounding units
Continuously moves toward the nearest <Leak Source>; increases in size and deals increased damage on death for each <Leak Source> touched, up to a maximum of 2 times.

enemies.name: Rampaging A-000
enemies.flavour_text: This Army experimental subject seems to have once been a fowlbeast. When its dark cage is opened, it flaps its wings, but it takes to the air in a different way. It still knows how to sing, though: air rushes into its lungs, inflating a gelatinous pustule.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Death deals a large amount of Physical damage to surrounding units
Continuously moves toward the nearest <Leak Source>; increases in size and deals increased damage on death for each <Leak Source> touched, up to a maximum of 2 times.

enemies.name: Trimortalis
enemies.flavour_text: Some Ursines believe that these terrifying flowers were watered with the cursed blood of those suffering from the strange sickness.

abilities.text: Deals Physical damage to the target when attacked.
Physical damage dealt to attacker temporarily increases and gains splash when affected by a <Leak Source>.

enemies.name: Sanguine Trimortalis
enemies.flavour_text: Some Ursines believe that these terrifying flowers were watered with the cursed blood of those suffering from the strange sickness. This is partially correct, but they were fed more than just blood.

abilities.text: Deals Physical damage to the target when attacked.
Physical damage dealt to attacker temporarily increases and gains splash when affected by a <Leak Source>.

enemies.name: 'Shishiga'
enemies.flavour_text: When the monsters take to the streets for the first time, their deformed limbs slapping people's homes, the people finally realize what experiments occurred in the secretive underground laboratories.

abilities.text: Next attack hits three times when affected by a <Leak Source>.

enemies.name: Angry 'Shishiga'
enemies.flavour_text: When the monsters take to the streets for the first time, their deformed limbs slapping people's homes, the people finally realize what experiments occurred in the secretive underground laboratories. They will no longer be slow, when their potential is fully unleashed.

abilities.text: Next attack hits three times when affected by a <Leak Source>.

enemies.name: 'Likho'
enemies.flavour_text: 'Never wake a sleeping Likho'—a saying in Ursus meaning not to stir up trouble where there is none. Also not to approach a sleeping Likho.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked
Creates a <Leak Source> nearby when defeated.

enemies.name: Roaming 'Likho'
enemies.flavour_text: 'Never wake a sleeping Likho'—a saying in Ursus meaning not to stir up trouble where there is none. Also not to approach a sleeping Likho. But perhaps the Likho, herald of misfortune, is coming for Ursus anyway.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked
Creates a <Leak Source> nearby when defeated.

enemies.name: 'Rusalka'
enemies.flavour_text: In Ursine legend, the Rusalka are the ghosts of young women who met an untimely death. A man who lost his wife and daughter started muttering the name 'Rusalka' at the sight of these mutated monsters, and the name stuck.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Continuously deals Arts damage to surrounding allied units.

When there is a <Leak Source> on the field, moves toward the nearest <Leak Source>; stops upon arrival for a period of time, gradually gaining ATK, and removes the <Leak Source> when the duration ends.

enemies.name: Dancing 'Rusalka'
enemies.flavour_text: In Ursine legend, the Rusalka are the ghosts of young women who met an untimely death. A man who lost his wife and daughter started muttering the name 'Rusalka' at the sight of these mutated monsters, and the name stuck. Today, the term has spread widely, as more and more people are losing their loved ones.

enemies.name: Ursus War Caster
enemies.flavour_text: These powerful War Casters were created through inhumane medication and training, by forcing the uninfected who survived such an ordeal to use powerful Arts units. As with everything else, the Empire seems unconcerned with how many die in the process.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Arts splash damage

Has a shield that protects against Physical and Arts damage. Shield is broken after taking a certain amount of damage in a single hit. Gains greatly increased DEF when shield is active, while RES is reduced. Shield is created when affected by a <Leak Source>.
Locks on to allied units, continuously dealing Arts damage and stealing a portion of the target's ATK.

enemies.name: Leak Source
enemies.flavour_text: People would bring tuskbeasts and let them howl at anyone running a fever, believing that their cry would scare away the evil spirits haunting the patient—that is, until the tuskbeasts began running fevers too.

abilities.text: Cannot be attacked
Not visible normally; increases ATK when it reveals itself.

Periodically fires a ring of beams that cause the first allied unit hit to take continuous True damage for a period of time, with closer units taking higher damage more frequently. When a beam hits a target, it accelerates the process of revealing the source.
Reveals itself after some time, firing more beams more frequently; leaves the field some time after revealing itself.

Revealed when an Operator is deployed on its tile or the four adjacent tiles; during this period, beams only affect the earliest-deployed Operator nearby; leaves the field after some time and gives all allied Operators SP.

enemies.name: AMa-10
enemies.flavour_text: 'Protect yourself, AMa-10. Survival is an instinct the living are born with.' At the time, she did not understand what could be worth giving up immortality for.

abilities.text: Cannot move or be teleported.
ATK gradually increases when attacking the same target
[Firewall] Has a Firewall around its 8 surrounding tiles; takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage from outside the firewall. Allied units cannot be deployed inside the Firewall.
[Refresh] Periodically teleports to the target tile and refreshes the Firewall.
[Information Flood] Releases a 3-tile-wide flood of information in a direction, causing the first unit hit to be stunned and continuously take True damage for a period of time.

enemies.name: AMa-10 Isomer
enemies.flavour_text: 'Kal'tsit, I hope you can protect the life on this great land.' She will return to us with a promise.

enemies.name: 'Alpha and Omega'
enemies.flavour_text: There is neither beginning nor end. It nurtures itself by devouring itself, in an eternal closed loop. Now, a gap has been opened in the loop, and she stands at its beginning.

abilities.text: Becomes Invulnerable upon losing a certain amount of HP. Takes damage and becomes stunned if a special interaction is performed within this duration; otherwise recovers HP.
[Firewall] Has a Firewall around itself; takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage from outside the Firewall.
[Information Flood] Releases a flood of information in a fixed direction, causing the first unit hit to be stunned and continuously take True damage for a period of time.
[Halt Process] When a long time has passed in the battle, disappears and drains 50 Life Points.
Cannot be teleported
